note: The built core combines this repository's code (MIT): the Chimera frontend in waterbox/core and the build scripts; Supermodel (GPL-3.0-or-later), compiled from the submodule extern/supermodel with this repository's patches/ applied, including the Musashi 68000 core and the Z80 core it carries under its GPL, and the libraries in its Src/Pkgs (GLEW, minizip, tinyxml2, minimp3); Mesa (MIT), whose llvmpipe driver behind OSMesa is the OpenGL Supermodel draws with (with this repository's waterbox/mesa-patches applied), and the zlib Mesa's build carries, which reads the game's zip; and LLVM (Apache-2.0 with the LLVM exception), which llvmpipe compiles the shaders with. The package carries no game and no ROM: the project brings the game's ROM set.
